notes.title: v1.6b - A simple, helpful update
notes.content:
This is a simple update that adds a video help section. Pressing "H" (or "Select" on controller) at any time in the game will bring up a help menu with various help topics about the game.

For those who think they don't need a full tutorial room or want a quick refresher, this may be helpful :)

tags.feature: This is a simple update that adds a video help section.

notes.title: Sigil Ghosts Have Arrived
notes.content:
Hello Investigators!

With the latest update sigil ghosts have arrived, as well as a few bug fixes and quality of life changes.

[u][b]Sigil Ghosts[/b][/u]
These ghosts will start appearing in the sightings computer after reaching level 11. Different from the normal ghosts you are used to, exorcising a sigil ghost requires a special sigil that's tied to a single ritual. To find that sigil, you must open the Tarot Chest and grab it from there. Then you can perform the one ritual that will exorcise the ghost.

[u][b]Other Fixes/Updates[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a sound effect when the Tarot Chest unlocks when placing the last tarot card down in the correct spot
[*] Modified the spirit mirror visual when the ghost is inside the favorite room to help make it more clear when the lights are on.
[*] Modified the container dot visual to try and make it more visible (still being tweaked but should help some for now.)
[*] Fixed some missed spelling mistakes
[*] Fixed a crash due to an errant debug command being possible to execute
[/list]

notes.title: Ready for a Road Trip?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940416/7b0deb985965942210e443e9eee88d991809bea8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ready for a Road Trip?[/h2]
The first post-story content update is being worked on and I'm ready to start sharing what it's all about. This update will be a new mode unlocked once you finish the main story (level 20). You'll be able to find this mode in the Sightings computer.

[h2]What is it?[/h2]
The Road Trip mode will be a new way to challenge yourself through a series of increasingly harder investigations that must all be completed before you can get the money and XP you've earned. You'll need to be careful since you can't leave these investigations early, and dying will end the whole Road Trip   without any rewards.

You invest in the road trip with an initial amount of money, and this is the only money you get to rent tools and items. You'll need to earn the rest of your money during the trip. From there will you tackle an investigation each night of the trip until you reach the end. You'll have the choice of 3 different ghosts each night. Some will be harder than others and some may even give a reward for the next investigation. It's up to you to choose how you progress through the Road Trip.

Upon completing the trip, you'll receive all the money and XP you earned during the trip as well as a special reward to mark your success in a Road Trip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940416/763b00e51c4ac63384cff1de2bb4d1d4d1096579.jpg[/img]

Get ready for more information on this mode in the coming weeks. Thanks and have fun!
